2000T2: The key's part 2.3 prints $83300\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}$ in the enthalpy term; this unit inconsistency is retained. This attributed Volume 2 compilation (Anton Sirota, IChO Information Centre, IUVENTA, 2009) has a teaching-copy grant with attribution, not a blanket commercial licence or assurance of an unchanged complete jury packet.

2000T3: The part 3.6 key labels its first result $K_1'$ rather than $K_2'$ and substitutes $2.19\times10^{19}$ rather than the given $2.4\times10^{19}$. Its part 3.7 has the nested factor $2(2\times\mathrm{Tyr(O^-)})$. These literal printed inconsistencies are retained. The source is Anton Sirota's attributed 2009 Volume 2 teaching collection, IChO Information Centre, IUVENTA; the teaching grant does not establish a blanket commercial licence or an unchanged complete jury packet.

2000T4: The fourth request is printed 4-1 in the question, whereas its key is numbered 4.4. The table prints “free notation” for alkanes. Both are retained. All three spectra and the structural answer drawings are native crops. This attributed Anton Sirota/IChO Information Centre/IUVENTA Volume 2 (2009) teaching collection does not establish a blanket commercial licence or an unchanged complete jury packet.

2000T5: The question labels 5-3 and the key labels 5-5 are preserved. The key uses 616034 in 5.1 and 616350 in 5.2. Its labelling calculation gives 658 pmol of labelled DNA and 66 μM without an explicit division for two ends; no alternative answer is substituted. This is the attributed Anton Sirota/IChO Information Centre/IUVENTA Volume 2 (2009) teaching collection, with teaching-copy conditions, not a blanket commercial licence or unchanged complete jury packet.

2000T6: The native 6.5 line prints “/100 × 0872 g mol−1”; the malformed expression is retained rather than reconstructed. Parts 6.6 and 6.9 omit a square on hydrogen carbonate; 6.6 also prints $4[\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}]/0.0751$ without a cubic exponent. Their printed numerical results are retained. This attributed Anton Sirota/IChO Information Centre/IUVENTA Volume 2 (2009) teaching collection has teaching-copy conditions, not a blanket commercial licence or unchanged complete jury packet.
